extracted.intended_audience: researchers, analysts, students, policymakers, and general public using The World Factbook country/reference data
extracted.subtask_description: Reference guide defining the data fields, codes, and explanatory notes used in The CIA World Factbook (2004) for compiling country and geographic-entity profiles. It enumerates field codes, rank-order guidance, appendixes, and detailed definitions for many entries (e.g., age structure, airports, economy fields, environment terms).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2001 — GDP (gross domestic product).

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2002 — Population growth rate (percent).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2003 — GDP - real growth rate (percent).

rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2004 — GDP per capita.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependency status
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2006 — Dependency status (formal relationship between a nonindependent entity and an independent state).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This entry describes the formal relationship between a particular nonindependent entity and an independent state.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation from the US
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2007 — Diplomatic representation from the US (chief of mission, embassy address, telephone, FAX, branch and consulate locations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes the chief of mission, embassy address, mailing address, telephone number, FAX number, branch office locations, consulate general locations, and consulate locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2008 — Transportation - note (miscellaneous transportation info).

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2010 — Age structure (percent distribution by age groups and sex).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides population distribution by sex and age group (0-14, 15-64, 65+). The age structure affects socioeconomic issues (e.g., need for schools vs. health care) and can help predict political issues (e.g., youth bulge and unemployment leading to unrest).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2011 — Geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector (%)

rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2013 — Radio broadcast stations (number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Television broadcast stations
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2015 — Television broadcast stations (number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio (male(s)/female)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2018 — Sex ratio (males per female).

rubrics_metrics.name: Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2019 — Heliports (number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes (m)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2020 — Elevation extremes (highest and lowest points in meters).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This entry includes both the highest point and the lowest point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2021 — Natural hazards (major environmental hazards affecting the entity).

rubrics_metrics.name: People - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2022 — People - note (miscellaneous population-related notes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2023 — Area - comparative (area comparison based on total area equivalents; comparisons often use the entire US, a US state, Washington DC, or The Mall).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides area comparison based on total area equivalents using US references; smaller entities compared with Washington, DC or The Mall.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - military age and obligation (years of age)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2024 — Military manpower: military age and obligation (years).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - fit for military service
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2025 — Military manpower: fit for military service (number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - reaching military age annually
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2026 — Military manpower: reaching military age annually (number).

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2028 — Background (major historic events and current issues; may include one or two key future trends).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Usually highlights major historic events and current issues and may include a statement about key future trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports - with paved runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2030 — Airports with paved runways: total number by runway length categories; for airports with multiple runways only the longest runway is included. Categories: (1) over 3,047 m, (2) 2,438–3,047 m, (3) 1,524–2,437 m, (4) 914–1,523 m, (5) under 914 m. Only usable runways are included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Runways counted whether concrete or asphalt; not all airports have refueling, maintenance, or ATC facilities. For airports with more than one runway only the longest runway is included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports - with unpaved runways
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2031 — Airports with unpaved runways: total number by runway length categories using the same five groups as paved runways; only usable runways included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unpaved surfaces include grass, dirt, sand, or gravel. For airports with more than one runway only the longest runway is included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2032 — Environment - current issues (lists the most pressing environmental problems and defines many environmental terms used).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a glossary of environment terms (acidification, acid rain, aerosol, afforestation, asbestos, biodiversity, bio-indicators, biomass, carbon cycle, catchments, DDT, defoliants, deforestation, desertification, dredging, drift-net fishing, ecosystems, effluents, endangered species, freshwater, greenhouse gas, groundwater, Highlands Water Project, Inuit Circumpolar Conference, metallurgical plants, noxious substances, overgrazing, ozone shield, poaching, pollution, potable water, salination, siltation, slash-and-burn agriculture, soil degradation, soil erosion, ultraviolet radiation, water-born diseases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2033 — Environment - international agreements (separates participation into 'party to' and 'signed but not ratified').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agreements are listed in alphabetical order by abbreviation; additional information appears in Appendix C: Selected International Environmental Agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - percent of GDP (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2034 — Military expenditures as percent of GDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - production (kWh)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2038 — Electricity production (annual kWh generated).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discrepancy between generated/imported and consumed/exported electricity is accounted for as loss in transmission and distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electricity - consumption (kWh)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2042 — Electricity consumption (annual kWh consumed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This entry consists of total electricity generated annually plus imports and minus exports, expressed in kilowatt-hours.

rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2048 — Labor force distribution by occupation (percent).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2049 — Exports - commodities (ordered list of major export commodities).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exports - partners (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2050 — Exports - partners (percent share by partner country).

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2052 — Agriculture products (ordered listing of major crops and products starting with the most important).

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2053 — Airports (total number; runways may be paved or unpaved but must be usable).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Not all airports have refueling, maintenance, or ATC facilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate (births/1,000 population)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2054 — Birth rate (crude birth rate: average annual number of births per 1,000 persons in population at midyear).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Birth rate is a dominant factor in population growth and depends on fertility level and age structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2055 — Military branches (list of service branches).

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2056 — Budget (includes revenues, total expenditures, and capital expenditures; figures calculated on an exchange-rate basis, not PPP).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital

rubrics_metrics.name: Imports - commodities
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2058 — Imports - commodities (major import commodities list).

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2059 — Climate (brief description of typical weather regimes throughout the year).

rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2061 — Imports - partners (percent share by partner country).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - donor
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2062 — Economic aid - donor (net official development assistance from OECD donors to developing countries and multilateral organizations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ODA is defined as concessional financial assistance with main objective of promoting economic development and welfare of less developed countries, containing a grant element of at least 25%. Entry does not cover other official flows or private flows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2063 — Constitution (dates of adoption, revisions, and major amendments).

rubrics_metrics.name: Economic aid - recipient
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2064 — Economic aid - recipient (net inflow of Official Development Finance to recipient countries; includes assistance from World Bank, IMF, etc.; formal commitments included; private grants omitted).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subject to definition and statistical coverage problems; includes new inflows minus repayments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2065 — Currency (national medium of exchange and basic subunit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate (deaths/1,000 population)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2066 — Death rate (crude death rate: average annual number of deaths per 1,000 population at midyear).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Death rate is affected by age distribution and may rise as populations age even as mortality at all ages declines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - dollar figure
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2067 — Military expenditures (dollar figure).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependent areas

rubrics_metrics.name: Disputes - international
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2070 — Disputes - international (range of situations from boundary disputes to unilateral claims and resource or irredentist issues).

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note

rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2121 — Railways total length in kilometers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2122 — Religions (percent distribution of major religions).

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example includes conventional long form, conventional short form, local long and short forms, former name, and abbreviation; see also Terminology note.

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total area: sum of land and water areas delimited by international boundaries/coastlines. Land area: aggregate of surfaces excluding inland water. Water area includes inland water surfaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephones - main lines in use
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2150 — Telephones (main lines in use).

rubrics_metrics.name: Telephones - mobile cellular
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2151 — Telephones (mobile cellular subscriptions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Distribution of family income - Gini index
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2172 — Gini index measures inequality in family income distribution (0 = perfect equality, 100 = perfect inequality).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculated from the Lorenz curve: ratio of area between Lorenz curve and 45° line to entire triangular area under 45° line. Lower values indicate more equal income distribution (example: 25 Scandinavian), higher values indicate more unequal distribution (example: 50 Sub-Saharan).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold

rubrics_metrics.name: Refugees and internally displaced persons
rubrics_metrics.description: Field code 2194 — Refugees and internally displaced persons (new Transnational issues category entry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Rank Order pages guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Rank Order pages are presorted lists of data from selected Factbook data fields, generally descending (highest to lowest) except Unemployment Rate and Inflation Rate which are ascending (lowest to highest).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rank Orders are available for specified fields across categories (Geography, People, Economy, Communications, Transportation, Military); not all fields include same number of entries due to missing data; Rank Order pages can be downloaded as tab-delimited data files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviations
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix A: Abbreviations includes all abbreviations and acronyms used in the Factbook, with their expansions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acronyms formatting rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on rendering acronyms: acronyms made solely from first letters of major words rendered in all caps (e.g., NATO). Acronyms made from more than the first letter rendered with only initial capital (e.g., Comsat). Hybrid forms sometimes used to distinguish between initially identical terms (WTO: WTrO and WToO).

rubrics_metrics.name: Country map
rubrics_metrics.description: Most versions provide a country map in color produced from the best available information at time of preparation; names and boundaries may have changed subsequently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Date of information
rubrics_metrics.description: In general, information available as of 1 January 2004 was used in preparation of this edition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entities classification
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines categories used in the Factbook: independent states, other (Taiwan, European Union), dependencies and areas of special sovereignty, miscellaneous, oceans, World (271 total entities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists specific counts and examples for independent states, dependencies by administering power, and miscellaneous entities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental agreements appendix
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix C contains selected international environmental agreements with name, abbreviation, date opened for signature, date entered into force, objective, and parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hydrographic data codes guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix E discusses hydrographic data code standards (IHO 23-4th, IHO 23-3rd, ACIC M 49-1, DIAM 65-18) and notes lack of US Government adoption of a standard comparable to FIPS 10-4 for hydrographic codes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains differences among standards, lack of coverage for whole oceans, and absence of standard for aggregating water bodies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix F - Geographic names cross-reference
rubrics_metrics.description: Appendix F lists geographic names with their Factbook entry and lat/long coordinates (e.g., Abidjan, Abkhazia, Abu Dhabi, etc.).
